latin: Motus est sensibile commune, a sensu exteriori absque actione alterius uirtutis cognoscibile.
translation: Motion, a common sensible, can be known by an outer sense without any other faculty coming into play.
translation_note: 'sensibile commune' kept as 'common sensible', the Aristotelian term for objects (motion, number, shape, etc.) perceived by more than one sense; cf. farmer1998:14035.
